title: Constrained Mean Field Games with Grushin type dynamics
summary: This paper is devoted to a class of finite horizon deterministic mean field games with Grushin type dynamics, state constraints and nonlocal coupling. First, we consider the optimal control problem that each agent aims to solve when the evolution of the population is given and we establish some properties as: the existence of an optimal trajectory for any starting point $(x,t)$, the closed graph property for the multivalued map which associates to each point $(x,t)$ the set of optimal trajectories starting from that point, endowed with a suitable notion of convergence, the continuity of the…
